d:
While Bhide warns the society about an impending 50% BMC water cut, the water in Gokuldham runs out unexpectedly. Jethalal gets trapped mid-shower covered in soap, forcing Daya to bring cold fridge water with ice cubes for him to bathe, which leaves him shivering with a severe cold.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
